5.  Set up the system of linear equations:
    *   $a + b = 4$
    *   $-5a - 3b = 0 \implies 5a + 3b = 0$
6.  Solving the system: From the first, $b = 4 - a$. Substituting into the second gives $5a + 3(4 - a) = 0 \implies 2a + 12 = 0 \implies a = -6$.
